adjudicated_statement: Work over C with Q-coefficients in the FND-0167 setup for (g,n)=(6,6). Let S be a reduced separated finite-type C-scheme of pure dimension 15 carrying the specified (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family. Assume its relative degree-six line bundle L is fibrewise base-point-free with h^0=3, formation of pi_*L commutes with base change, and A=P_S(pi_*L) is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle of dimension 17. Let Delta be the non-reduced-divisor locus of dimension 16, U=A\Delta, and Z=Ord(U)->U the finite etale right S_6-torsor. Assume the FND-0167 construction gives an injection Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U;Q)=Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q)^{S_6} into Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) direct-sum Gr^W_14 H_c^14(S;Q)(-1) direct-sum Gr^W_12 H_c^12(S;Q)(-2). If all three target summands are sums of Q(-8), then the invariant corner of Z is also a sum of Q(-8); the converse implication is invalid, and the existence of a non-Tate type-(15,1) class in the first target summand does not imply a non-Tate class on U or Z. Nor does the localization sequence establish survival of that class from A to U merely by dimension: dim Delta=16 does not force F^15 H_c^16(Delta;C)=0. Consequently ATT-0118 refutes the universally quantified (H-S) conjunct but, by this route alone, neither refutes nor proves the Z-clause. This conclusion concerns only the ATT-0118 fibre-degree-zero route and does not assert that the Z-clause is globally open or unaffected by other constructions.
contradiction_resolution: The mandatory originating artifacts were checked at their contested passages. ATT-0118, especially argument_markdown section 4 and CLM-0118-5, proves that its type-(15,1) class falsifies the universally quantified (H-S) j=8 conjunct and therefore falsifies the quoted conjunction as written; it does not construct a class on U or Z. REV-0166 confirms that conjunct-level disproof while explicitly observing that the counterexample never touches Z. The FND-0167 arrow has source Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U;Q), identified by transfer with Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q)^{S_6}, and target the direct sum of three constant-coefficient corners of S. Hence Tate-ness of the target propagates to the source, by strictness and semisimplicity of pure polarizable Hodge structures, but a non-Tate target does not force a non-Tate subobject. Moreover, placing the ATT-0118 class in the fibre-degree-zero summand of H_c^16(A) does not establish that it survives restriction to U: because dim Delta=16, Deligne's dimension bound permits Hodge index p=15 in H_c^16(Delta), so it supplies no F^15-vanishing. This is a failure of the proposed lifting argument, not proof that the class dies. The candidate's unqualified sentence that Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q) remains open is contradicted as a global campaign statement by FND-0176 and FND-0178, which use a different product-family and fibre-degree-two route to produce a non-Tate invariant Z-corner. The defensible observation is therefore limited to the ATT-0118 first-summand route. It duplicates the already corroborated FND-0171, with related coverage in FND-0169 and the route distinction recorded in FND-0177, so FND-0175 should be merged into FND-0171 rather than promoted independently.

The relative degree-six line bundle L is fibrewise base-point-free with h^0=3, formation of pi_*L commutes with base change, and A=P_S(pi_*L) is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle of dimension 17.
